You will hear a number of different recordings and you will have to answer questions on what you hear. There will be time for you to read the instructions. Instructions and questions and you will have a chance to check your work. All the recordings will be played once only. The test is in four parts. At the end of the test you will be given 10 minutes to transfer your answers to the answer sheet. Now turn to part 1. You will hear a woman phoning a friend to get information about a job agency.
